entry.title: aws/aws-sdk-net - Releases - 2026-11-13
entry.content:
4.1.2.0

4.1.2.0 (2026-11-13 19:12 UTC)

  • AppStream (4.1.1.0)
    • Amazon WorkSpaces Agent Access now supports image builders, so AI agents can install, configure, and test applications before you create an image. New Replay Session delivers a video of screenshots, a transcript, and a report for each agent session, optionally encrypted with your own KMS key.
  • CloudFormation (4.1.1.0)
    • AWS CloudFormation introduces stack aliases, which let you refer to an existing stack by a new name without deleting and recreating it. Manage aliases with SetAlias and RemoveAlias, and use an alias in place of the stack name in operations such as UpdateStack.
  • CognitoIdentityProvider (4.1.1.0)
    • Adding support for dynamic client registration.
  • ConnectCampaignsV2 (4.1.1.0)
    • Adds LastModifiedTime to DescribeCampaign and ListCampaigns responses.
  • Deadline (4.1.1.0)
    • AWS Deadline Cloud now supports the NVIDIA RTX PRO 4500 GPU accelerator (rtx-pro-4500) for service-managed fleets running Amazon EC2 G7 instances.
  • DevOpsAgent (4.1.1.0)
    • AWS DevOps Agent adds bidirectional communication for Microsoft Teams associations. Set msteams.bidirectional with an IAM role so the agent answers mentions in your Teams channels.
  • DocDB (4.1.0.1)
    • Update the documentation for the --engine-version flag for cluster creation
  • EC2 (4.1.2.0)
    • Adds support for Networking Flexible Cost Allocation APIs, enabling Network Admin, Architect, and Engineers to break down shared networking costs by the resources that generated the traffic.
  • Glue (4.1.1.0)
    • Field description update for auto upgrade summaries
  • IAMRolesAnywhere (4.1.1.0)
    • This release adds resource aliases for IAM Roles Anywhere trust anchors, profiles, and certificate revocation lists (CRLs). Assign an optional, unique alias name to a resource and use its alias ARN wherever an identifier is accepted, including CreateSession.
  • IdentityManagement (4.1.1.0)
    • Minor documentation updates only
  • Imagebuilder (4.1.1.0)
    • Add documentation clarification around List API behavior, and add image available waiter
  • Lambda (4.1.1.0)
    • Adds support for customer-managed runtimes in the CreateFunction and UpdateFunctionConfiguration APIs. Functions can now use a customer-managed runtime and receive its updates automatically, or pin to a specific runtime version using the existing runtime controls.
  • LambdaCore (4.1.1.0)
    • Initial release of the customer-managed runtime APIs. Runtime publishers can now create, version, and manage custom runtimes, and use aliases to roll out new runtime versions to the functions that use them.
  • NetworkFirewall (4.1.1.0)
    • Releasing Firewall Proxy API and deprecating Egress Proxy API.
  • Organizations (4.1.1.0)
    • Add support for policy operations on the SECURITYHUB CSPM POLICY policy type.
  • QConnect (4.1.1.0)
    • Amazon Q in Connect now supports additional message template attributes. You can personalize message templates using case fields, Amazon Connect Customer Profiles calculated attributes, and product recommendations.
  • SageMaker (4.1.2.0)
    • New feature for Sagemaker Hyperpod Slurm clusters to install Extensions and view cluster operations.
  • Scheduler (4.1.1.0)
    • Adds EventBridgePutEventsV2Parameters and EventBridgePutRawEventsParameters to Target so schedules can publish to Amazon EventBridge event bus v2 with PutEvents or PutRawEvents.
  • SecurityHub (4.1.1.0)
    • New DISABLED status for Security Hub CSPM Central Configuration.
  • SimpleSystemsManagement (4.1.1.0)
    • Adding Google Cloud Platform (GCP) support to SSM Cloud Connector to enable onboarding of GCP Compute Engine instances to AWS Systems Manager. Customers can now optionally create an SSM Cloud Connector without an AWS Config connector.
  • VPCLattice (4.1.1.0)
    • Amazon VPC Lattice now supports modification of resource configuration DNS resolution on Resource Gateways
  • Core 4.1.0.1
    • Reduce per-request overhead in the HttpClient adapter: cheaper response header copy, reuse of the generated User-Agent string, request Uri and standard HttpMethod instances, and skipped attribute building for no-op telemetry providers.
    • Reduce SigV4 signing CPU and allocations: reuse keyed HMAC instances on .NET 8, build the scope, string to sign and Authorization header with interpolated strings, and use the known hash for empty payloads. Signatures and headers are unchanged.

entry.title: Azure/azure-sdk-for-net - Releases - 2026-11-13
entry.content:
Azure.AI.Extensions.OpenAI_3.0.0

3.0.0 (2026-11-12)

Breaking Changes

  • Removed the synchronous ProjectResponsesClient.CreateResponseStreaming overloads. Use CreateResponseStreamingAsync and asynchronous enumeration.
  • ProjectResponsesClient.CreateResponseStreamingAsync overloads now return
    Task<AsyncStreamingResult<StreamingResponseUpdate>> instead of
    AsyncCollectionResult<StreamingResponseUpdate>. Await stream creation
    before enumerating updates.
  • The ProjectConversationsClient constructor now accepts ConversationClientOptions instead of OpenAIClientOptions.
  • ProjectResponsesClient.GetResponseStreamingAsync now yields strongly typed response items.
  • ProjectResponsesClient's experimental diagnostic changed from OPENAI001 to AAIP002.

Other Changes

  • Updated the OpenAI package dependency to 2.15.0. See the OpenAI 2.15.0 release notes for the upstream breaking changes to experimental APIs, including the async-only streaming methods that ProjectResponsesClient inherits.

Sample Updates

  • Synchronous streaming samples were removed, because streaming in synchronous scenarios is not supported anymore.

entry.title: dotnet/SqlClient - Releases - 2026-11-13
entry.content:
Stable Release v7.0.4

This servicing release includes security updates, certificate and enclave-session validation fixes, and improvements to result reading and managed networking.

Use matching 7.0.4 versions of the driver and companion packages. Assemblies retain AssemblyVersion 7.0.0.0; no new .NET Framework binding redirects are required when upgrading from 7.0.3. Microsoft.SqlServer.Server is unchanged and versioned independently.

Changes Since 7.0.3

Changed

  • Updated dependencies to address CVE-2026-84008: System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs 8.0.2 for net462/net8.0/netstandard2.0 and affected .NET 9 dependencies to 9.0.21.
  • Updated native SNI dependencies to 6.0.4.
  • Updated user-agent telemetry to v2 and added compatibility-switch reporting. Async behavior and switch defaults are unchanged.

Fixed

  • Enforced an explicit HostNameInCertificate during managed SNI certificate validation, even when the certificate matches the server name (net8.0/net9.0). (#4908)
  • Isolated Always Encrypted enclave-session cache entries by attestation protocol. (#4867)
  • Fixed unobserved receive exceptions and packet cleanup when closing managed SNI connections with MARS reads pending (net8.0/net9.0). (#4950)
  • Fixed SqlDataReader.HasRows returning false when informational messages precede the first row. (#4899)
  • Fixed statistics timer races throwing "Nullable object must have a value." Connection and MARS use remain non-thread-safe. (#4897)
  • Fixed sequential GetTextReader reads corrupting nvarchar text on big-endian platforms. (#4962)
  • Rejected malformed PRELOGIN responses with a corrupted-stream error instead of IndexOutOfRangeException. (#4978)
  • Rejected row, alternate-result, and authentication responses missing required metadata or state, and prevented affected connections from returning to the pool. (#4982)

Companion Packages

All packages below ship as 7.0.4.

Package Highlights
Extensions.Azure Added actionable guidance for Windows WAM window_handle_required errors, preserving the original error code and inner exception.
AlwaysEncrypted.AzureKeyVaultProvider Version alignment only; no functional or API changes.
Extensions.Abstractions Version alignment only; no functional or API changes.
Internal.Logging Version alignment only; internal use, not for direct application references.

For Windows WAM errors, provide a parent window through SetParentActivityOrWindowFunc, or use Authentication=Active Directory Default with a configured non-interactive credential in windowless hosts. Interactive authentication without WAM requires a custom ApplicationClientId and UseWamBroker=false. WAM remains enforced for SqlClient's first-party application ID; no automatic fallback was added.

Platform Support

.NET Framework 4.6.2+ on Windows and .NET 8.0+ on Windows, Linux, and macOS. Companion package targets and dependency lists are included in the linked package notes.

Thanks to LaurensVergote for contributing.

Full release notes and dependency versions

  • Updated native SNI dependencies to 7.1.2.
